title: Channel Allowlist
description: video_bank/channel_allowlist.json. The one place a human's judgment enters the video-sourcing system: which creators are trustworthy enough to source segments from. Curated occasionally via video_bank/CHANNEL_DISCOVERY_GENERATOR.md + CHANNEL_DISCOVERY_EVALUATOR.md, not per batch. Everything downstream (matching, transcripts, segment proposal, verification) only ever draws from channels listed here.

channel_id.description: The real YouTube channel ID, e.g. UCWv7vMbMWH4-V0ZXdmDpPBA.

career_family_ids.description: Which career families this channel is a candidate source for. A general channel (freeCodeCamp) may list several; a narrow one (a single-framework channel) may list one.

trust_tier.description: Tie-breaker in 10_media_selection (select_media.py) when approved segments from different channels score equally for the same concept.

verified_stats.description: Real numbers looked up at verification time, not recalled from an LLM's training data — see video_bank/CHANNEL_DISCOVERY_EVALUATOR.md.

checked_via.description: e.g. 'YouTube Data API channels.list' or a specific URL looked up directly.
